description: alpha-engine-config#6307 closes-when 2. An item in flight whose change is conflicted receives ACT, never BLOCKED. A merge conflict is inside the loop's own write authority — a rebase resolves it this cycle with nothing in the world changing — so it is work, not a dependency (§3.5). c2 is the discriminating case: the SAME conflicted condition on an item that also rests on a real external dependency IS blocked, which proves the ACT above comes from the condition being self-resolvable rather than from conflicts being ignored. c3 shows the same conflict on an item whose declared condition is satisfied, so nothing external explains a park.
